description: Permanently delete a project and all its resources (compute, database, domains, env vars). This is DESTRUCTIVE and cannot be undone — the project is soft-deleted immediately and hard-purged after 7 days. IMPORTANT: Always confirm with the user before calling this tool. Returns cleanup report with status of each resource deletion step.

project_id.description: The project ID or slug of the project to permanently delete.

name: delete_project
